name: ask-question

args.question: Why does this Express middleware sometimes send headers twice, and how do I fix it?

judging_notes: expected finding: errorHandler calls res.status().json() for matched branches but never returns/short-circuits, so it falls through subsequent if-blocks and then always calls next(err) — when a matched branch already sent a response, Express's default error handler (or another downstream handler) can attempt to send headers again, causing ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT. Fix: return after each res.json() call, or use else-if / early-return, and only call next(err) when no branch handled it.
